evidence.evidence_summary: 42-game career, 2458 rush yards (5.4 YPC), 15 TDs. 1.15 YPRR, 27.5% avoided tackle rate. Efficient runner, limited receiving role. Qualifies for dual-threat RB flag (100+ rush YPG + 1.0+ receiving YPTPA/G; same list as Saquon, CMC, Bijan — 2026 members: Skattebo, Hampton, Emmett Johnson). MTF/attempt 88th percentile — notable but sub-elite (elite threshold: 90th+). Final-season YACO/A: 2.95 — tied 3rd-worst among R3-4 P4/5 RBs since 2017 (comp group: Gallman 2.98, Conner 2.95*, Johnson 2.95, Shipley 2.92, Davis-Price 2.80, Kelley 2.80, Hill 2.68, Ballage 2.46, Corum 2.42; *Conner underwent chemotherapy). Dual-threat qualification is a positive signal; YACO/A comp trend toward poor NFL outcomes remains the key concern. Model skepticism (rank 26-27) still warranted.
